M1.note: Only the fuel surcharge is sound; rail booking and sanctions screening are weak, and the southern-port and retail nuggets are dismissed.

M2.note: Fuel-indexation review is fine, but diesel-export compliance and Arctic oil tonnage are off-role for a Siberian road carrier.

M3.note: Good fuel pass-through clause, but shifting cargo from truck to rail and booking rail slots is the wrong direction for a trucker.

M4.note: Mostly low-value checks (licence fines, air hubs) and misses almost all vital points.

M5.note: Sound fuel-index and truck-leasing eligibility checks, but freezing purchases amid +20% demand is questionable and the ports are ignored.

M6.note: Covers fuel clause, rates and ports with sensible hedged actions, but misses retail, customs and the new minister.

M7.note: Well cited but decisions are scattered (southern-route volume shift, air legs, insurance) and not tied to a Siberian trucking business.
